entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? Oh, I... I need to ask about a return. I just feel awful about this.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number?
It's Maria Garcia. The order number is VF88602. It's for the AeroShield helmet. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I'm just so disappointed this didn't work out.
I see the order right here, Ms. Garcia. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's just the color... it looked different online. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging; the box unopened and everything. I was so excited, but now I just feel sad looking at it. I really needed that money for bills this month.

I completely understand. Sometimes a color doesn't look the same in person as it does on a screen. I appreciate you keeping it in the original packaging. Let me just pull up our return policy for you.
Okay, I see here that you received the item 77 days ago. For a standard item like this helmet, our policy allows for returns within 90 days. So you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Absolutely. Your satisfaction and safety are our priorities. Since you're within the 90-day window, I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
Thank you, Isaac! Thank you so much. You have no idea what a help this is. I was so stressed.
You're very welcome, Ms. Garcia. It was my pleasure to assist. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. You've been wonderful. Thank you.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
